# Veerachit Jaruthanadech (วีรชิต จารุธนเดช)

> Veerachit Jaruthanadech (วีรชิต จารุธนเดช), known as VJ, is an entrepreneur and CEO based in Bangkok. Since 2006 he has built five companies across branding, AI transformation, global sourcing, print, and food & beverage.

## Facts

- Name: Veerachit Jaruthanadech. Thai: วีรชิต จารุธนเดช. Nickname: VJ.
- Role: Entrepreneur and CEO. Based in Bangkok, Thailand.
- Companies: Avery & Co (branding), Avery AI (AI transformation), Avery Global (Asia-focused sourcing), Papery (print production), Claypot King (food & beverage).
- Education: University of the Arts (HfK) Bremen, Germany.
- Credential: Google AI Professional Certificate.
- Contact: hello@veerachit.com

## Essays

- [AI ช่วยพิสูจน์สมมติฐานรีมันน์ได้แล้ว นี่คือ Singularity หรือยัง](https://veerachit.com/thoughts/ai-riemann-hypothesis-singularity/) (2026-11-26): โจทย์อายุ 167 ปีถูกปิดลงด้วยคนหนึ่งคนกับ AI หนึ่งตัว บทเรียนสำหรับธุรกิจไม่ใช่เรื่องซูเปอร์อินเทลลิเจนซ์ แต่อยู่ที่ว่างานไหนตรวจคำตอบได้
- [Ask a Machine Who You Are](https://veerachit.com/thoughts/ask-a-machine-who-you-are/) (2026-11-04): Long before any singularity, AI has become the first reader of your company. It can only repeat what it can read and connect.
- [The Company of 2040](https://veerachit.com/thoughts/the-company-of-2040/) (2026-11-04): Everyone will rent the same intelligence. The company of 2040 will be defined by what it refuses to delegate.
- [องค์กรไทยต้องปรับตัวอย่างไรในยุค AI ปี 2027: เมื่อ Branding และ AI Transformation เป็นเรื่องเดียวกัน](https://veerachit.com/thoughts/how-thai-corporates-must-adapt-to-ai-in-2027/) (2026-11-04): องค์กรไทยใช้ AI เร็วขึ้นมาก แต่ส่วนใหญ่ยังอยู่ระดับพื้นฐาน ปี 2027 จะแยกองค์กรที่ทำเป็นออกจากองค์กรที่แค่มีเครื่องมือ
- [Singularity คืออะไร และธุรกิจไทยควรเตรียมตัวอย่างไร](https://veerachit.com/thoughts/what-the-singularity-means-for-thai-business/) (2026-11-04): ไม่มีใครรู้วันที่ แต่คำถามที่ธุรกิจต้องตอบพรุ่งนี้เช้าชัดอยู่แล้ว
- [The Case for Boring AI](https://veerachit.com/thoughts/the-case-for-boring-ai/) (2026-10-20): The AI that changes a company most is often one short message a day.
- [Where AI Systems Actually Break](https://veerachit.com/thoughts/where-ai-systems-actually-break/) (2026-10-14): Not in the model. In the quiet shared parts everything else is waiting on.
- [Label It by Hand First](https://veerachit.com/thoughts/label-it-by-hand-first/) (2026-10-08): Before you automate customer feedback, read it yourself. The categories you need are not obvious.
- [Why Leaders Should Go Back to Class on AI](https://veerachit.com/thoughts/why-leaders-should-go-back-to-class-on-ai/) (2026-10-02): Daily AI use builds deep but uneven knowledge. A structured course shows leaders where they have been guessing.
- [Headcount Is No Longer the Unit](https://veerachit.com/thoughts/headcount-is-no-longer-the-unit/) (2026-08-12): For decades, companies were sized by how many people they took. That number is losing its meaning.
- [Taste Is the Last Moat](https://veerachit.com/thoughts/taste-is-the-last-moat/) (2026-07-15): When everyone can generate, the only thing left to compete on is knowing what is good.
- [Give Your Company a Memory](https://veerachit.com/thoughts/i-gave-my-companies-a-memory/) (2026-06-18): The jump is rarely a smarter model. It is the day the system stops forgetting.
- [The Edit Is the Work](https://veerachit.com/thoughts/the-edit-is-the-work/) (2026-04-15): Good work is not about what you add. It is about what survives the cut.
- [Why AI Won't Replace the Brief](https://veerachit.com/thoughts/why-ai-wont-replace-the-brief/) (2026-03-20): Every tool that changed how people work has one thing in common. It still needs a question.
- [Premium Is a Decision](https://veerachit.com/thoughts/twenty-years-one-rule/) (2026-02-10): Premium is not a price point. It is a decision, made early and defended when it is expensive.
- [Claypot and Code](https://veerachit.com/thoughts/claypot-and-code/) (2026-01-18): A claypot kitchen and an AI practice face the same question: what to preserve when everything moves fast.
- [Bangkok and Hong Kong Are Not the Same City](https://veerachit.com/thoughts/bangkok-and-hong-kong-are-not-the-same-city/) (2025-12-05): One city moves fast and trusts instinct. The other moves fast and demands proof. Both are right.
